core_en: All behaviour has a goal — even when you do not notice it. Real change means changing those hidden goals.
core_zh: 所有行为背后都有一个目标，哪怕你自己没意识到。真正的改变，是换掉那些藏起来的目标。

diagram.caption_en: Words can mislead. Actions do not. Watch actions to see the real goal.
diagram.caption_zh: 语言会骗人，行动不会。看行动，才能看到真正的目标。

label: Chapter 02 · 看清真正的目标

paragraphs.en: You walk forward because you want to arrive somewhere. You scratch because you want the itch to stop. Most goals are this clear. But many goals are unconscious.
paragraphs.zh: 你往前走，是因为想去某个地方；你挠痒，是因为想让痒停下来。大多数目标就是这么直接。但很多目标是无意识的。

paragraphs.en: For example, you say you need a break, but you are really trying to escape discomfort. You say you want to quit a boring job, but your actions say you want to stay safe. The excuse sounds kind — “I need the money” or “I need rest” — but it can hide the truth from yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 比如你说“我需要休息一下”，其实是想逃避不舒服的感觉；你说想辞掉无聊的工作，行动却说你想待在安全区。借口听起来很合理 —— “我需要钱”“我需要休息” —— 但它可能是在骗自己。

paragraphs.en: So do not only watch your words. Watch your movement. What you do every day shows what you truly want.
paragraphs.zh: 所以别只听自己说了什么，要看自己做了什么。你每天的行动，才说明你真正想要什么。

title_en: Your real goal may be hidden behind your words
title_zh: 你嘴上说的，不一定是心里想要的

vocab.example_en: I procrastinate when a task feels hard.
vocab.example_zh: 任务一难，我就开始拖延。

vocab.def_zh: 无意识的；没察觉到的。反义词 conscious（有意识的）。
自欺欺人。deceive = 欺骗，self- = 对自己。
vocab.example_zh: “我只是在休息”可能是自欺欺人。

vocab.def_zh: 为……找理由；证明合理。justification 是名词。
vocab.example_en: Don’t justify it. Just look at what you did.
vocab.example_zh: 别找理由了，看看你实际做了什么。
